name: test-scattering-parameter-calibration-data-on-wafer-10mhz-to-110ghz
title: Test scattering parameter calibration data for on-wafer measurements from 10 MHz to 110 GHz
description: This dataset contains S-parameter measurements for on-wafer calibration standards from 10 MHz to 110 GHz. The data includes 15 different calibration standards (open, short, load, thru, etc.) in Touchstone (.s2p) format, referenced to 50 ohms. Measurements were performed as part of the NIST CHIPs R&D Metrology Program project 'calnet.nist.gov' to support traceable on-wafer metrology.

sources.title: CHIPS R&D Metrology Program Project Plan: calnet.nist.gov
